company.name: Helsing
company.shortDescription: Helsing develops artificial intelligence software, autonomous systems, and defense technologies for military and government applications.
company.description: Helsing develops artificial intelligence software, autonomous systems, and defense technologies for military and government applications. Its products include AI-enabled software for reconnaissance, electronic warfare, underwater surveillance, autonomous aircraft, and strike drone operations, along with systems that connect existing defense equipment into AI-enabled networks. The company also designs autonomous air, land, and underwater platforms that support data processing, mission planning, and operational decision-making. In addition, Helsing works with government and industry partners to integrate AI capabilities into defense infrastructure and supports the development and deployment of software-defined autonomous systems.
